description: This file defines the WorkWeekController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The controller handles pre-rendering setup for the 'work-week' Vue component, particularly preparing an array of day types with internationalized labels for the UI.

classes.name: WorkWeekController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the 'Work Week' UI component, setting up data for rendering, particularly the different work day types with internationalized labels.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with props, specifically an array of day types with translated labels, before rendering the UI.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the list of data groups required for capability authorization checks.
